pages.html:
🧘Serenity Yoga
About Schedule Testimonials Sign Up

Welcome to Serenity Yoga Studio

Find your inner peace through mindful movement and breath

Start Your Journey Today

About Our Studio

Mindful Teaching

Our experienced instructors guide you through each pose with intention and compassion, helping you connect body, mind, and spirit.

Welcoming Community

Whether you're a beginner or advanced practitioner, you'll find a supportive environment where everyone belongs and can grow.

Holistic Wellness

We believe in treating the whole person. Our classes integrate yoga, breathing techniques, and meditation for complete well-being.

Class Schedule

Join us for classes throughout the week. All levels welcome.

What Our Students Say

"Serenity Yoga has transformed my life. I came in stressed and anxious, and after just a few weeks of classes, I feel calm and centered. The instructors truly care about each student."

— Michelle R.

"I've tried many yoga studios, but this one stands out. The community is warm and welcoming, the classes are well-structured, and I've noticed real improvements in my flexibility and strength."

— Robert K.

"As a beginner, I was nervous about starting yoga. The instructors at Serenity made me feel comfortable and confident from day one. I'm so grateful for this space."

— Jessica L.

"The 6 AM sunrise flows have become my favorite part of the day. I start every morning energized and ready to take on the world. Highly recommend!"

— Thomas W.

Ready to Begin?

Join Serenity Yoga Studio and discover the peace that comes from within. New students receive a free introductory class!

Serenity Yoga Studio

123 Wellness Avenue, Portland, OR 97214

Phone: (503) 555-0142

Email: hello@serenityoga.com

Hours: Monday–Friday 6:00 AM–8:00 PM, Saturday–Sunday 8:00 AM–6:00 PM
